answer: A concrete approach: chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. Link analysis on reused seeds marks the whole set. Because it works by requiring post-paid stake that is forfeited on detection, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. The network ties the ledge to sunk effort, uses the knoll as an corroborating signal, then requires a jetty before any payout.
